$schema_note: Mutation-score ratchet baseline (FR-251 Gap #4). One entry per (tool, target) pair. Values are the highest mutation score (% of mutants killed) recorded for that target. CI jobs `python-mutmut`, `frontend-stryker`, and the C++ Mull job compare current score against the recorded baseline and FAIL when the score drops. The baseline ONLY GOES UP. Empty initial state — first CI run on master seeds it.
_seeding_instructions: After the first successful CI run on master, paste the per-target mutation score (as a float 0-100) into the corresponding entry above. Until seeded the entry stays null and the ratchet is a no-op for that target.
